<p><span style="font-weight: 400;"></span><b>Rosebuds Stainless Steel Butt Plug - Heliotrope - 2 Sizes</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">With its glimmering Heliotrope crystal, the Rosebuds Stainless Steel Butt Plug is body jewelry. Made from mirror-polished stainless steel, each Rosebuds is polished by hand. The classic tapered shape is designed for easy insertion. Rosebuds create a weighty feeling and can intensify vaginal sensation, or put pressure on the prostate. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lab-tested to meet US and European CE safety standards, Rosebuds plugs are easy to keep clean and shining. They’re available in two compact sizes, “medium” and “large.” </span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stainless steel jewel plug</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">“Heliotrope” colored Swarovski crystal embedded in base</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mirror finish: polished by hand</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Classic tapered shape for easy insertion</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thin neck helps lock plug into place</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lab-tested stainless steel</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Available in two sizes</span></li>
</ul>
<p><b>Dimensions</b></p>
<p><i><span style="font-weight: 400;">Medium: </span></i><span style="font-weight: 400;">1.18” width; 2.95” length</span></p>
<p><i><span style="font-weight: 400;">Large: </span></i><span style="font-weight: 400;">1.38” width; 3.35” length</span></p>

<p><b>BMS</b> <b>PalmPower Extreme Ultra-Powerful Rechargeable Wand Vibrator</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The PalmPower Extreme is the newest, strongest PowerBullet vibrator by BMS Factory! This wand massager is intensely powerful, with 7 bone-rattling preset functions. Or switch to incremental speed control: press and hold until you find your desired intensity level. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">PalmPower Extreme’s handle features an ergonomic angle for comfortable grip. The smooth silicone head is available in two colors, Black and PalmPower Fuchsia. Extreme is cordless and rechargeable for freedom as you play. </span></p>

<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Very powerful wand vibrator</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Angled handle for easier grip</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">4 steady speed levels &amp; 3 patterned functions</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Or switch to Incremental Speed control: press &amp; hold to reach your desired intensity</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stronger than previous PalmPower wands!</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cordless and rechargeable </span></li>

<p><b>Uberrime Night King Fantasy Dildo, Fire &amp; Ice Colors</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Not for the faint of heart, the Night King Dildo by Uberrime is a handcrafted fantasy toy that won’t leave you wanting. Inspired by the icy GOT character, the Night King features a phallic head and an incredibly detailed, textured shaft, all in a soft silicone. This dildo’s long length is great for depth play or wrapped around for external stimulation. With a wide, flared base, the Night King is safe for all bodies.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;"> <span>This item includes <strong>FedEx 2-Day Air</strong> shipping to anywhere in the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii. </span><i>Please note: Orders must be placed by 1 p.m. EST to receive same-day shipping.</i></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This version of the Night King comes in Fire &amp; Ice colors: a flaming yellow to red upper shaft transitions into a beautiful bright blue. The Night King is </span><a href="https://www.peepshowtoys.com/products/uberrime-night-king-silicone-dildo"><span style="font-weight: 400;">also available here in character colors</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: a frigid silver &amp; bright blue to dark blue.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Made of certified skin-safe platinum silicone in the USA, all Uberrime Dildos are a one-of-a-kind work of art. The colors in each hand-poured toy come out slightly differently, so two toys ever look the same.</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Handmade fantasy dildo</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Body-safe platinum silicone</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Fire &amp; Ice coloration</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Medium-soft silicone (approximately 8A)</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Long length &amp; pronounced ridged texture</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Compatible with many harnesses (see base diameter for details)</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Handcrafted in the United States</span></li>
</ul>
<p><b>Dimensions: </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maximum diameter: 1.7”; Total length: 9”; Usable length: 8”</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Available in Fire &amp; Ice theme colors: Yellow &amp; red marbled into blue. </span></p>

<div class="product-single__description rte" itemprop="description">
<p><b>Le Wand Chrome Collection Bullet Elegant Rechargeable Vibrator</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Le Wand Chrome Bullet’s sleek metal body will let strong vibes resound. This bullet vibrator also includes two stimulating silicone sleeves that will bring variety to your play session. Use it either internally or externally, exploring its 11 vibe modes plus 4 different intensity levels. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Le Wand Chrome Bullet is fully waterproof, USB rechargeable, and travel-friendly. All Le Wand Chrome vibes are as well suited for a fashion &amp; lifestyle photo shoot as for your nightstand!</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sleek, stylish bullet vibe</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Vibes resound through the polished metal body</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">11 vibration modes &amp; 4 intensity levels</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Includes 2 textured silicone sleeve attachments</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">One-button controls</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Waterproof submersible</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Compact &amp; discreet</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Travel-friendly: includes a velvet storage pouch &amp; travel lock function</span></li>
</ul>
<p><b>Dimensions: </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">0.75” wide; 3” long</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Available in Rose Gold or Black. </span></p>

<p><b>b-Vibe Vibrating Snug Plug Weighted Silicone Butt Plugs with Vibration 2 Sizes</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The b-Vibe Vibrating Snug Plug takes </span><a href="https://www.peepshowtoys.com/products/snug-plug-weighted-silicone-butt-plug-by-b-vibe"><span style="font-weight: 400;">the original Snug Plugs’ </span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">weighted silicone design and adds vibration! Feel even more as you explore your Vibrating Snug Plug’s 4 vibration levels plus 6 vibration patterns. This powerful anal vibrator is waterproof and USB rechargeable. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span>This item includes <em><strong>FedEx 2-Day Air</strong></em> shipping to anywhere in the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii. </span><i>Please note: Orders must be placed by 1 p.m. EST to receive same-day shipping.</i></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Vibrating Snug Plug features a thin, flexible neck for easy long-term wear, as the torpedo-shaped body locks comfortably into place. The sleek anchor base is designed to sit perfectly between the butt cheeks. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Vibrating Snug Plugs are available in 2 size and weight options: beginner-friendly and more advanced! </span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Vibrating weighted silicone plug</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Powerful vibrations: 4 vibe levels and 6 vibe patterns</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Rounded tip for easy insertion</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Torpedo shape provides a feeling of fullness</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thin, flexible neck allows for easy wear</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Smooth grip base sits comfortably between the butt cheeks</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">2 size options: for the anal beginner, or for the more experienced</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Waterproof and USB rechargeable</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Silky, seamless silicone exterior</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Includes travel/storage case &amp; expert-written Guide to Anal Play</span></li>

<p><b>Rosebuds Stainless Steel Butt Plug - Clear Swarovski Crystal - 2 Sizes</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Rosebuds Stainless Steel Butt Plugs are beautiful body jewelry. Made from mirror-polished stainless steel, each Rosebuds is embellished with an authentic Swarovski crystal. Their classic tapered shape is designed for easy insertion. Rosebuds create a weighty feeling and can intensify vaginal sensation, or put pressure on the prostate. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lab-tested to meet US and European CE safety standards, Rosebuds plugs are easy to keep clean and shining. They’re available in two compact sizes, “medium” and “large.” </span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stainless steel jewel plugs</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Swarovski crystal embedded in base</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mirror finish: polished by hand</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Classic tapered shape for easy insertion</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thin neck helps lock plug into place</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lab-tested stainless steel</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Available in two sizes</span></li>
</ul>

<p><b>Em.Ex. by Sportsheets Active Harness Wear Contour Harness</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Sportsheets Contour Harness is a comfortable jock-style harness that conforms to your body. The Contour Harness includes 2 bullet vibe slots for extra sensation. Perfect for long-term wear, its wicking material controls moisture. Contour’s fabric is soft, while the elastic waistband is durable. Interior fabric panels offer even more support.</span></p>

<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Jock-style harness</span></li>

<div class="product-single__description rte" itemprop="description">
<p><b>Kegelbell Weighted Kegel Training System</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">An FDA-registered device, the Kegelbell Weighted Training System is guaranteed to deliver results within weeks. Stronger pelvic floor muscles allow for better urinary control, easier postpartum recovery, more sensation during sex, and stronger orgasms.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span>This item includes <strong>Free FedEx 2-Day Air</strong> shipping to anywhere in the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii. </span><i>Please note: Orders must be placed by 1 p.m. EST to receive same-day shipping.</i></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Kegelbell System includes two insertable bulbs (small and large sizes), from which the user hangs their preferred weight. The set includes weights between 30 and 250 grams, progressing upward in 30-gram increments: a total of 16 difficulty levels! Customize your training regimen to meet your individual needs, and move up in weight at your own pace.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Kegelbell recommends using your training kit for 5 minutes at a time, 3 times a week, for the first 2 weeks to begin to feel results. The kit includes a full instruction manual to help you achieve maximum Kegel strength.</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Complete, FDA-registered Kegel training collection</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Includes 2 insertable bulbs and 3 sets of weights</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Improve control, recover or increase vaginal strength, &amp; enhance sensation</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Medical-grade silicone bulbs plus silicone-coated weights</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Customize your training routine with different weight amounts</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">From 30g to 250g weights, for 16 difficulty levels</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">2-week challenge with guaranteed results</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Intended for short-term workouts, so you spend less time training</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Complete instruction guide and storage bag included</span></li>
</ul>
<p><b>Dimensions: </b></p>
<p><i><span style="font-weight: 400;">Small insertable bulb:</span></i><span style="font-weight: 400;"> 30mm/30g </span></p>
<p><i><span style="font-weight: 400;">Large insertable bulb:</span></i><span style="font-weight: 400;"> 35mm/40g</span></p>
